The NWS daytime forecast high at queue time was 88F, so this threshold sits +2F from forecast. Resolves from the NWS observed daily high for the station on the local calendar date.
rules: Resolve Yes if the NWS observed daily maximum temperature at Miami (MIA, FL) on 2026-05-21 (local calendar date) is strictly greater than 90F. Resolve No otherwise. Use the official NWS observed daily high.

market_snapshot.notes: NWS daytime forecast high 88F at queue time; threshold +2F from forecast to keep the event uncertain. Resolve from observed daily high, not the forecast.

notes: Weather threshold calibration candidate; non-sports domain. Needs the dedicated NWS observed-high resolver (not auto_resolve_finance).
